upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.intro: The next three days on the schedule — MLB and the Mexican leagues — with first-pitch times, probable pitchers, and where to watch or listen. Finals drop off; this is the look-ahead.
upcoming.emptyBody: No games are posted for the next few days across MLB or the Mexican leagues. Check back when the next slate is announced.

scoreboard.title: Live Today
scoreboard.intro: Every game on today's card — live scores, the count, who's on and who's up. The board refreshes itself every 30 seconds while this tab is open.
scoreboard.emptyTitle: No games on the card today
scoreboard.emptyBody: Nothing is scheduled for today, or the first pitch hasn't been posted yet. Check back closer to game time.
scoreboard.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh just now — showing the board as last loaded.
scoreboard.errBody: Couldn't reach the MLB API just now. Check your connection and try again.

footer.app: Data from the public MLB Stats API · proxied server-side to keep the browser CORS-free.
footer.landing: Reads MLB's public Stats API. Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, MLB or any club.

landing.heroSubtext: Live MLB standings and deep player stats, painted like a ballpark scoreboard. Sort the board, follow your club, read the forecast.
landing.liveQuiet: No games are live this minute. First pitches light up the board the moment they're thrown — until then, take a look at what's on today's card.
landing.boardDark: The board is dark right now. It lights up the moment the feed answers.
landing.featuresHeading: Built for the fan who reads the box score twice.
landing.sortTitle: Sort the board the way you read it
landing.sortBody: Click any column to rank by wins, win percentage, or games back. Your reading order, not the league's default.
landing.followBody: Pin your team and it floats to the top of every division, saved in your browser between visits.
landing.deepBody: Full hitting and pitching lines, Statcast expected stats, team rank, and a season forecast on one card.
landing.feedBody: Live numbers pulled from MLB's public Stats API through a server proxy, flattened and refreshed on demand.
landing.deepDiveTitle1: From a division race down to
landing.deepDiveBody: Tap a club, walk its roster like a lineup card, and open a player to see the numbers behind the number.
landing.ctaBody: Six divisions, thirty clubs, every stat line. No account, no paywall.

board.title: Standings
board.intro: Tap any team for its roster and stat lines, a column heading to sort, or the star to follow a team and float it to the top. The amber lamp marks each division leader.
board.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh just now, showing the {season} board as last loaded.
board.errBody: Couldn't reach the MLB API just now. Check your connection and try again.
board.emptyBody: No standings are posted for the {season} season yet. Pick another year from the dropdown above.

division.caption: {division} standings: wins, losses, winning percentage, and games behind the leader

team.rosterErrBody: The team id may be wrong, or the API is unreachable.

team.noMatch: No one on the roster matches “{q}”.
team.emptyPrompt: Pick a player from the lineup to light up their stat line.

statline.empty: No {name} stat lines for this season yet.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.caption: Amber = out-performing expected contact (often unsustainable); clay = under-performing.
